findings.title: Repository baseline captured
findings.evidence: HEAD 3f9d144; package 276.1.0; no local main ref is available.
findings.currentStatus: Current checkout and tracked baseline are inspectable.
findings.notes: Pre-existing ignored build directories are excluded.

findings.title: Authoritative Texas county and community projection
findings.evidence: Projection contains 254 counties, 1859 canonical communities, 2058 memberships, and 163 multi-county identities.
findings.notes: No historical total was assumed; current file was counted.

findings.title: Statewide address packages exist with integrity evidence
findings.evidence: LP130 final reconciliation records 254 packages, 254 sidecars, unique FIPS, and zero missing packages.
findings.currentStatus: WAS MISSING is superseded; package presence IS NOT MISSING NOW.
findings.notes: Package presence is not live provider certification.

findings.title: Statewide live address/search behavior is not currently certified
findings.evidence: The tracked LP104.5 runtime manifest lists only Liberty while candidate packages cover 254 counties; this audit executes no private/live query.
findings.currentStatus: Statewide exactness, fallback truthfulness, rendering, selection, and route handoff remain unproven.
findings.requiredAction: Execute and sign off the 254-county privacy-safe fixture plan against the launch deployment; record provider/result fields and resolve every WRONG_RESULT or false-success outcome.
findings.notes: A centroid or unrelated road cannot pass as an exact address.

findings.title: Canonical statewide crossing authority
findings.evidence: LP239 certification has 1,859 rows and zero failures.
findings.currentStatus: Static canonical crossing identity and membership parity pass statewide.
findings.requiredAction: Run bounded owner journey samples only.
findings.notes: Runtime positive/empty and interactions remain in acceptance plan, not fabricated.

findings.title: Statewide Official Roadways artifacts and LP240 presentation
findings.evidence: LP210 remote manifest and LP211 activation inventory are tracked; LP240 tests protect road-first labels and condition-owned actions.
findings.requiredAction: Owner verifies bounded active, quiet, stale and provider-failure journeys.

findings.title: Selected-area NWS and LP240 weather contracts

findings.requiredAction: Owner validates active, quiet, transition and forced-failure cases.

findings.title: Report persistence lifecycle requires launch-deployment proof
findings.evidence: Static tests cannot prove production Supabase persistence, RLS, confirm/clear, rehydration, or truthful submission failure.
findings.currentStatus: End-to-end launch environment evidence is absent from this audit.
findings.requiredAction: Complete the finite report submit, refresh, area-switch, confirm/clear, duplicate, abuse-control and forced-failure acceptance run.

findings.title: Box Canyon contract remains unresolved

findings.currentStatus: Open; a static statewide pass does not resolve it.
findings.requiredAction: Owner must reproduce Box Canyon in Val Verde context and decide expected Alerts/KBYG/Location Context propagation and camera movement, then retain screenshots and result.
findings.notes: Historical evidence located; no current pass claimed.

findings.title: Physical compatibility and accessibility acceptance
findings.evidence: Static inspection finds manifest/service-worker/geolocation paths, but no LP241 physical-device or assistive-technology run exists.
findings.currentStatus: Touch, keyboard, focus, text scaling, reduced motion, orientation, safe-area, installed-PWA and screen-reader behavior remain unproven.
findings.requiredAction: Complete the bounded device matrix; fix only demonstrated barriers and record exact device/browser versions.

findings.title: Owner visual tour not yet executed
findings.evidence: Static surface inventory exists; current portrait screenshots were not fabricated.
findings.requiredAction: Capture the specified portrait-first side-by-side tour and classify observed issues.
findings.notes: Launch impact escalates only with traveler-facing evidence.

findings.title: Final public-launch legal approval is open
findings.evidence: LP184.1D is draftOnly, pass=false, closed=false, and blocksPublicLaunch=true.
findings.currentStatus: Draft policies exist but are not final public-launch authority.
findings.requiredAction: Obtain appropriate professional/owner approval, publish effective documents and verify support/privacy contact paths plus required attribution/disclosures.
findings.notes: This is evidence reporting, not a legal conclusion.

findings.title: PWA static assets and lifecycle contract exist
findings.evidence: Manifest provides standalone/start_url/scope/icons; service-worker registration and lifecycle code are present.
findings.currentStatus: Static configuration present; install/update recovery needs device proof.
findings.requiredAction: Cover install, offline shell, update, stale client and online recovery in device run.
findings.notes: Static proof is not installability proof.

findings.title: Launch-day operational go/no-go evidence
findings.evidence: Historical rollback/incident artifacts exist, but LP241 has no current deployment ID, provider-health capture, current rollback rehearsal, named incident owner, or abort record.
findings.currentStatus: Current release controls require bounded owner sign-off.
findings.requiredAction: Record release SHA/deployment ID, provider health/quota, monitoring owner, rollback command/rehearsal, backup status, and explicit abort thresholds.

findings.title: Performance requires bounded owner measurements
findings.evidence: Static inspection cannot establish first usable interaction or transition latency on launch devices.
findings.requiredAction: Measure startup, area switch, sheets, search, route and report refresh while checking listener/interval accumulation.
findings.notes: rAF/setInterval/forced-reflow observations alone are not defects.

findings.title: Broader analytics and polish iteration
findings.evidence: No current evidence makes broader optimization a launch requirement.
findings.currentStatus: Defer unless acceptance demonstrates material harm.
findings.requiredAction: Track real traveler outcomes after launch.
